label: copy-phase input c early in recall, esp. before o/c
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input token is c (the fed-back copy of an original c). Every activation has in_tok == c. It is not first occurrences, so original-phase c never fires, and the delimiter step never fires. It is limited to early recall positions (recall_idx 1-3; recall_idx <= 3 keeps 99.8% of mass) and gets more likely and stronger when many outputs remain (to_go 4-7, longer L). Magnitude is highest when the token being output next is o or c (bigrams co / cc in the original, about 70% of mass) and when r or x come later. Still, only about 4% of early copy-phase c inputs fire, so the gating is sparse and only partly captured. Silent on every other input token, in the original phase, and at late recall positions.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=2 & in_tok=c (+5.24), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=c (+4.85), recall_idx=3 & in_tok=c (+3.39), phase=2 & in_tok=c (+2.72), phase=2 & out_tok=c (+2.71), phase=2 & out_tok=o (+2.63). Lower it: next_out=- (-2.09), orig4=u (-1.97), orig4=1 (-1.69), orig4=- (-1.62).
